replaces.idea: A freestanding two-tier slate-and-brass mail-sorting cabinet on stubby feet with one glowing mint-green parcel, representing two-dimensional EPT guest-to-host page translation.
A bolted iron railway switchstand with a weighted hand lever and semaphore target plate that gates DMA tracks into physical memory.
A cylindrical pneumatic-tube dispatch canister on a cradle stand with a glowing status band, representing a posted-interrupt descriptor.
A wall-mounted mechanical ticker-tape register with twin brass spools and a notched paper strip, representing an IOMMU fault log.

new.name: Two-Level Mail Sorter
new.depicts: A freestanding slate-and-brass mail-sorting cabinet on four stubby feet with two stacked tiers of cubbies and one glowing mint-green parcel
new.focal: the glowing mint-green parcel in the lower-right cubby

new.name: DMA Switchstand
new.depicts: A grounded iron railway switchstand bolted to a baseplate with a tall weighted lever and a slotted semaphore target plate

new.name: Interrupt Canister
new.depicts: A cylindrical pneumatic-tube dispatch canister resting on a cradle stand with a brass end-cap and a glowing mint-green status band

new.name: Fault Tape Reel
new.depicts: A wall-mounted mechanical ticker-tape register with two brass spools and a short strip of notched paper tape hanging down

new.name: Cached Address Stamp
new.depicts: A wooden-handled rubber desk stamp resting in a shallow ink-pad tray on a small pedestal

new.name: Root Pointer Plaque
new.concept: EPTP (Extended Page Table Pointer) & IOMMU Root Table

rework.redesign: Redraw as a grounded twin-towered gatehouse bridged by a catwalk with glowing mint-green signal lamps.
Ground the four stepping blocks as a solid stone staircase with a mint-green lantern resting on the bottom step.
Reshape into a squat hexagonal beetle-like translation bug with two 1x1 dark-ink eyes and a notched mint-green carapace.
